## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines the base class CustomBehaviour which can be inherited from by specific targets (ex.</p>


<p>llvm/tools/llvm-mca/lib/X86CustomBehaviour.h). CustomBehaviour is designed to enforce custom behaviour and dependencies within the llvm-mca pipeline simulation that llvm-mca isn't already capable of extracting from the Scheduling Models.</p>
